stats.title: Pomodoro Session
stats.sqlQuery:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_pomodoro_sessions
FROM PomodoroSessions WHERE createdAt BETWEEN :period_start_date AND :period_end_date;
stats.sqlTotalQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_pomodorosessions FROM PomodoroSessions WHERE createdAt BETWEEN :period_start_date AND :period_end_date

stats.title: Task
stats.sqlQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_task FROM Tasks WHERE createdAt BETWEEN :period_start_date AND :period_end_date
stats.sqlTotalQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_task FROM Tasks

stats.title: Task Note
stats.sqlQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tasknote FROM TaskNotes WHERE createdAt BETWEEN :period_start_date AND :period_end_date
stats.sqlTotalQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tasknote FROM TaskNotes

stats.title: Notification
stats.sqlQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS notification FROM notifications WHERE created_at BETWEEN :period_start_date AND :period_end_date
stats.sqlTotalQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_notifications FROM notifications

cards.title: Number of Users
cards.sqlQuery: SELECT DATE(createdAt) as date, COUNT(*) as user_count FROM users WHERE createdAt BETWEEN :period_start_date AND :period_end_date GROUP BY DATE(createdAt) ORDER BY date

cards.title: Pomodoro Complete
cards.sqlQuery: SELECT DATE(createdAt) as date, SUM(completed) as completed_true, COUNT(*) - SUM(completed) as completed_false FROM PomodoroSessions WHERE createdAt BETWEEN :period_start_date AND :period_end_date GROUP BY DATE(createdAt) ORDER BY date
